title: Robert Moses's unbuilt highways would have cut through about 3,600 buildings that stand today
description: Whose utopia? Robert Moses drew one man's perfect city of expressways through other people's neighborhoods. Many were built, like the Cross Bronx and the BQE. Four he lost: the Lower Manhattan, Mid-Manhattan, Bushwick and Cross-Brooklyn expressways. This map traces those unbuilt routes through today's city and counts the buildings and people now standing in their path.
